annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2025/14 on the approval and market surveillance of non-road mobile machinery circulating on public roads and amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2025/14 on the approval and market surveillance of non-road mobile machinery circulating on public roads and amending Regulation (EU) 2019/1020
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation establishing harmonised EU type-approval, individual approval and market surveillance for self-propelled non-road mobile machinery (category U) circulating on public roads. It sets road-safety technical requirements via delegated acts, economic operator duties, technical service rules and safeguard procedures, and mentions fully automated and remotely operated driving systems. Applies from 29 January 2028.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU type-approval and individual approval required for non-road mobile machinery (U category) with design speed 6–40 km/h
Commission to adopt delegated acts on road-safety technical requirements, possibly covering driver assistance and automated/remote driving
Member States may restrict circulation of machinery with fully automated or remotely operated driving systems under national traffic law
Obligations for manufacturers, importers, distributors; technical services designated and notified
Applies from 29 January 2028; national approvals allowed until 29 January 2036
